purpose: Separate audited execution rules, AI budget priority, AI investment multiplier and one common electronics input coefficient; keep official scores fixed.
baseline: Frozen v12 economics and legacy official score, with storage, extra bonus inputs and machine upkeep experiments OFF.

ai_factors.operating_first: Reserve virtual wallet for food, then only installed-capacity next-cycle ore/fuel shortage, then missing household electronics, then research/project extra raw. Merge each raw good into one execution row; preserve original trading order and transaction tags. No added negotiation opportunity. A reserved but unavailable input can tie up the living-goods budget; measure that downside.
ai_factors.remove_durable_boost: Change only original early durable industry multiplier 1.8 to1; retain scores other terms, threshold, cash/raw/household guards, route choice/waiting and focus rules.

economic_factor.name: electronics_extra_raw
economic_factor.scope: For every country, each electronics production cycle at industry level>=2 consumes one additional bundle of that cycle existing alternating raw type. Level1, starting goods, machine recipe, research materials, prices, cash fees and score rules unchanged.

economic_pilot.requires: root review of saved AI pilot; no user reconfirmation required

economic_pilot_trigger: Inspect the AI pilot first. If the resource-sector cash-flow disadvantage remains under the AI changes, examine the already defined common electronics input candidate. This is an exploration trigger, not an assumption that trade deficits are necessarily unfair.
fixed_after_pilot: No new coefficient fitting from final results. Final modes and source/test/protocol hashes frozen before main/stress.
behavior_comparisons: Same mode and same stress seeds, each focal and mixed profile against the normal stress control; compound Mechania-idle profiles additionally versus Mechania-idle alone.
primary_metrics: cash sales and purchases by good, never mislabeled profit
AI-selected legal, affordable, feasible and successful investment attempts
own produced units actually used, by good
production shortages and food shortage rounds
unmet opportunities, unused stock and its accounting valuation
secondary_metrics: unchanged legacy official totals for original six
frozen v12 targets view without refitting
maximum score frequency and within-world range, not an equal-win target
interpretation: All agents are rule based. No human classroom evidence or simultaneous cloud app test.
Policy effects propagate through the market; paired seed comparisons are controlled policy effects, not isolated one-transaction effects.
Cash sales minus all purchases is a cash trade balance, not manufacturing profit; purchases include living consumption.
Investment opportunity counts concern the AI selected project, not all possible legal projects.
Raw trade is not automatically useful; distinguish an imported unit, its production use and downstream output use.
Retain any adverse result and exceptions. Do not adopt a change only because Technia loses or Mineria gains.
The 3 mixed automated profiles are limited stress examples, not all student country assignments.
stop_rule: After meaningful regression checks, the declared runs, independent accounting/source checks and report-number QA, stop optional testing and deliver the candidate verdict. Do not silently turn exploratory options into confirmed rules.
